newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and Soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and Soy steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values were mostly steady on Wednesday amid a lack of export activity, export sources said.
Hard red winter and soft red winter CIF prices were mostly unchanged. "It is so quiet, it is ridiculous," a dealer said.
Also high water levels on the upper Mississippi River continued to hamper barge traffic.

River officials have shifted their attention to rising water levels on a section of the Mississippi River from Dubuque, Iowa south to Chester, Ill. as water on upper reaches of the Mississippi slowly falls.
"From Dubuque, Iowa to Chester Illinois, there is the highest water levels area now," said Bob Hildebrand, chief warrant officer, Coast Guard Marine Safety Office at St Louis.
High water also forced more lock closures on the Mississippi River near Pleasant Valley, Iowa, and southward, the Coast Guard said.
